s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging soft-tissue mass over the dorsum of the hand with a history of prior malignancy
salient_findings: 2-month history of a gradually enlarging mass
Soft-tissue mass over the second metacarpal dorsum with mild tenderness
Presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells in an inflammatory background
key_facts: 25-year-old man
History of Hodgkin lymphoma
Diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma 6 years earlier
Received 13 courses of chemotherapy
Mass located over the dorsum of the left hand
Mass measures approximately 4 cm in greatest dimension
Mild tenderness with no limitation of movement
Microscopic examination shows a mixture of inflammatory cells and myxoid stroma
Presence of epithelioid and spindle-shaped cells, lipoblast-like cells, and occasional Reed–Sternberg–like cells

shortlist.label: Myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the microscopic examination findings of a mixture of inflammatory cells and myxoid stroma with epithelioid and spindle-shaped cells

shortlist.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with the presence of myxoid stroma and lipoblast-like cells in the microscopic examination

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of inflammatory cells and myxoid stroma in the microscopic examination, along with a history of prior malignancy

shortlist.label: Liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Given the patient's history of prior malignancy and the presence of lipoblast-like cells in the microscopic examination

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging soft-tissue mass with mild tenderness

raw.rationale: The presence of a mixture of inflammatory cells, myxoid stroma, epithelioid and spindle-shaped cells, lipoblast-like cells, and occasional Reed–Sternberg–like cells is most consistent with Myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma, which is known for its complex and variable histological appearance.

rejected.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of distinct lipoblastic differentiation and absence of characteristic liposarcomatous features

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: Absence of typical myofibroblastic proliferation and lack of ALK-1 expression

rejected.label: Liposarcoma
rejected.why: Insufficient lipoblastic differentiation and absence of characteristic liposarcomatous features

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Less prominent inflammatory component and lack of Reed–Sternberg–like cells
